items.source: Provides convenience methods to process a FreeMarker template with a model.
items.translation: 提供便捷方法来使用模型处理 FreeMarker 模板。

items.source:
When using this method to prepare text for a mail to be sent with Spring's
mail support, consider wrapping IO/TemplateException in MailPreparationException.
items.translation: 在使用此方法为使用 Spring 邮件支持发送的邮件准备文本时，请考虑将 IO/TemplateException 包装在 MailPreparationException 中。

items.source: IOException - if the template wasn't found or couldn't be read
items.translation: IOException - 如果找不到模板或无法读取该模板

items.source: model - the model object, typically a Map that contains model names as keys and model objects as values
items.translation: model - 模型对象，通常是一个 Map，其中键为模型名称，值为模型对象

items.source:
Process the specified FreeMarker template with the given model and write
the result to a String.
items.translation: 使用给定的模型处理指定的 FreeMarker 模板，并将结果写入字符串。
